topic: Why Apples Float in Water While Pears Immediately Sink
title: Why Apples Float While Many Pears Sink 🍎🍐
false_sentence: Freezing nights and warm days create pressure that pushes tree sap up.
correct_version: Keep every line about apples and pears. Apples float because about a quarter of an apple's volume is air, which makes it less dense than water; most pears are denser and sink. (Freeze-thaw pressure pushing maple sap is real, but it belongs in a maple video.)
why: the line about maple sap is true, but it has nothing to do with apples and pears
